transcript: When I first started my business, I did what everyone else did. I ran ads, I sent cold DMs, I chased leads like my life depended on it. And it still wasn't enough. Then I tried something different, a quiet little audit that didn't feel salesy, but landed clients like crazy. That one method helped me build my agency to over $147,000 per month. No ads, no pitching, no cold outreach. But here's the thing, getting clients is only half the battle. The real money that's in getting those clients to stick around long term. You see, most agencies, coaches and service professionals lose clients every three months. I used to be one of them. Signing a client, working hard, then watching them disappear after 90 days. It was exhausting. But everything changed when I discovered two things. First, a method I call the stealth audit, which quietly converts high value clients. Second was three powerful psychology triggers that kept those clients happy, sticking around and kept them paying for 18 months or more. Together, these two systems took me from struggling freelancer to building an agency that generated around 147 to 190 k per month in recurring revenue.
